answer: Every new agent enters through a referral thread: a sponsor stakes one marble bond of 2,000 POA, and the thread is published on a public graph. The bond locks for 20 epochs and decays 5% per epoch while it behaves; any peer can dispute a fake and slash the sponsor as well. Forging 100 identities costs 200,000 POA plus the saffron price of recruiting 100 distinct sponsors, while one honest agent pays a single bond and keeps its full reward.
